note: TestRFC5036UnknownTLVWithUBitSetIsSkipped checks an unknown TLV with U=1 is skipped, the mapping is applied and nothing is written; TestRFC5036UnknownTLVWithUBitClearIsRefused checks U=0 draws the Unknown TLV Notification referring to the Label Mapping, the mapping is not applied and the session stays up. TestLDPInitUnknownTLVUClearNotifies (rfc5036_init_unknown_tlv_test.go) checks the same U=0 half for an Initialization: DecodeInit refuses with unknownTLVError, Session.ignoreUnknownTLV answers an Unknown TLV Notification referring to message 7 of type Initialization, processMessages returns nil and the session stays in OpenSent, so the whole message is ignored.
